Practo is generally better for an all-in-one healthcare experience with medicine delivery, lab tests, and a massive doctor directory. [Lybrate](https://www.lybrate.com/) works best if you want quick, budget-friendly online Q&A and straightforward specialist access. Your choice depends on whether you need a full digital health ecosystem or a simple consultation tool.

- **Large network:** Huge database of local doctors, clinics, and hospitals with verified user reviews.

- **All-in-one services:** Offers in-person clinic bookings, video/chat teleconsultations, medicine orders, and diagnostic lab test booking.

- **Health records:** Stores your digital prescriptions and medical history securely in one place

### Lybrate Overview

- **Quick advice:** Features a popular online Q&A forum where users can ask health questions and get professional advice.

- **Cost-effective:** Frequently praised for streamlined, budget-friendly digital consultations.

- **Specialist focus:** Good direct line for specific health disciplines and general practitioner chats.
